description:
Meet the Low Kicker. Whether you're dreaming of smooth daily commutes, comfy all-day rides, loaded tours, or gnarly gravel adventures, the Low Kicker is your perfect companion.
The graceful, swoopy top tube of the Low-Kicker, is designed for ease and comfort. Perfect for mounting and dismounting a fully loaded bike, this lowered top tube also makes frequent stops in urban environments a breeze. And for those with limited flexibility, the Low-Kicker offers a practical and stylish ride with modern features and generous clearances—something that's been missing until now.
The Low Kicker boasts impressive tire clearance. With fenders, it comfortably fits 650b x 48 or 26 x 2.3” smooth tires. If you skip the fenders, it’s ready to tackle 650b x 2.1” or 26 x 2.3” knobby tires.
The Low Kicker features star reinforcements on almost every braze-on, ensuring durability and strength. The rear brake routing is internal, with a brazed-in tube that makes installation a breeze—no more fishing for housing!
You'll find dedicated rack and fender mounts on the rear, perfect for all your cargo needs. The fork, with its elegant French-style bend, includes braze-ons for versatile mounting options. Whether you want to attach rando-style front racks, side-mounted cargo cages, or low-rider pannier racks, the Low Kicker has got you covered.
The integrated seat collar adds a touch of elegance to its robust design.
And, of course, it wouldn’t be a Velo Orange frame without the perfectly aligned fender mounts, ensuring flawless fender installation every time.
Get ready to ride in style and tackle any terrain with the Low Kicker!

Water bottle mounts: Triple on top of downtube, triple on top of toptube, one set on underside of downtube

Frame Eyelets: Double eyelets on rear dropouts for racks and fenders. Internal eyelets on seat stays

Fork Eyelets: Double eyelets on fork dropouts for racks and fenders. Triple thru-bosses on the blades for lowrider racks for cargo cages. Hourglass braze-on for front racks like our Flat Pack Rack or Porteur Rack.

If you are getting a VO Headset along with your frame, you can get it installed for a reasonable fee. Simply click here to navigate to the installation page, and add the fee to your order before checkout.
